description: Transport statistics indicators for Malawi (38 data sets, Transport Data Commons starter data kit) is a series of data sets listed in Transport Data Commons (Transport Data Catalogue), a transport data catalogue, published or maintained by Transport for Cairo. Number of freight airports from the Ministry of Transport, Malawi. Coverage: Malawi. The portal lists 38 near-identical data sets in this series (one per event, year, area or country), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for Cairo. Its tags are Aviation, Freight. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2025-06-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tdc-portal.
